title: Local VLM Review Pipe (Proposals Only)
status: built + tested (268 passed) + smoke-tested on one unit; NO batch run; NO verified labels; NO training

high_value_scope.selection_guard: UE001/STR001/SP002 refused; no selection is an argparse error; full run requires explicit --batch

evidence_mapping.frame: extracted/<sid>/sequence/frame_%04d.jpg target (+/-1 neighbours as [CONTEXT], optional via --no-frame-context)

smoke_test.visual_evidence: consistent smooth extrusion, no stringing/spaghetti/under-extrusion visible

limitations: VLM confidence is uncalibrated; not ground truth
frame-unit live path only dry-run verified; only a sequence request hit the live server
retries bounded by design; repeated identical invalid JSON exhausts retries to an explicit error
batch = 120 sequential requests, no concurrency/rate limit
upsert never purges stale proposals for untouched units
manifest fractional times for 23.976 fps sources are cosmetic; frame identity consistent
next_step: human completes review_manifest.json (Stage 12D merge) and optionally runs the explicit --batch VLM run; compare human labels vs VLM proposals before the Experiment 2 decision
